scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Cover Story Logistics
cards.instruction: Accept that a secret plan exists, then focus on schedules, witnesses, explanations, cleanup, and what everyone must remember.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, we're planning a secret picnic. Who explains the rented bus?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll say it's a school trip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On Sunday, with forty adults and a cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll use cars instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now whose drive hides forty adults' cars?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For Dad's surprise picnic, where can forty guests board the bus unseen?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Outside my shop. Dad never goes there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Tell everyone to arrive separately so the neighbours don't mention a crowd.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Dad's offered to open the shop for me while I organise it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then board at the library. Ring all forty guests; no group message Dad might see. Who's collecting him after we leave?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 accepts the secret picnic; A3 tests its explanation and A5 addresses concealing cars.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's school trip causes A3's Sunday objection; B4's cars cause A5's parking question.

relationship.evidence: B4 changes the transport plan constructively, letting A5 tackle its new concealment problem.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's solution into the larger problem of hiding forty adults' cars.

specificity.evidence: A1's secret picnic and rented bus become Sunday's forty adults and cake in A3.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's compact list punctures the school-trip cover; A5 earns its logistical complication.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 accepts the surprise picnic; A3 manages witnesses, and A5 coordinates relocation, discreet notification and Dad's collection.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 supplies the shop as a concealed boarding point, prompting A3's staggered arrivals; B4 puts Dad there, directly requiring A5's relocation.

relationship.evidence: B2 helps organise the surprise, while B4 reveals that Dad's helpful offer compromises their arrangement and changes A's options.

heightening.evidence: B4 turns their safe location into an exposure risk; A5 expands the response to forty individual calls and a separate collection arrangement.

specificity.evidence: A1 immediately establishes forty guests, a bus and Dad's surprise picnic; B4 gives the shop opening a concrete family explanation.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's concern about neighbours develops into A5's forty telephone calls: an earned logistical burden, although the last turn packs in several tasks.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 offers the shop; A3 accepts it and addresses the remaining risk of neighbours reporting a crowd.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 places Dad at the boarding location; A5 changes the location and specifies how to notify guests without exposing the surprise.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 consistently accept secrecy and work through witnesses, communications and transport.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes protecting the surprise require forty calls and another transport arrangement, while leaving the planning open.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A accepts secrecy and continually translates the plan into practical requirements for maintaining its cover.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary logistical fussing concerns transport efficiency; this card concerns what observers will notice and believe.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 tests whether a school-trip explanation survives scrutiny; A5 asks where the replacement cars can be hidden.

records.recommendedEdit: Retained the candidate's family picnic and shop setting, replacing the exposed shopping cover with a library pickup. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A3 manages witnesses and A5 coordinates concealed communication; logic 5, B2's shop prompts staggered arrivals and B4's shopkeeper Dad forces relocation and separate collection; relationship 4, B2 offers a site and B4 reveals helpful family involvement that compromises it; heightening 4, A5 turns one location change into forty calls and another pickup; specificity 4, A1/B2 establish guests, bus and shop, while library availability remains proposed; wit 4, A5's forty individual calls earn their mundane burden from secrecy. Total 90. Five spoken turns, 73 words; original firstPass preserved.
records.remainingConcern: The behaviour is close to competent surprise-party planning, so the comic excess is modest. No rewrite needed for an internal pass.
records.writerReservation: The library's suitability still needs B's response, and Dad seeing a group message is a possibility A guards against, not an established fact. The quiet logistical burden needs sincere delivery; this is model review only.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved alternative audits a retrospective cake-delivery alibi against transport and witness evidence. This candidate manages a large group's prospective movements and adapts to Dad's helpful intervention.

cards.title: One Suspicious Detail
cards.instruction: Choose one ordinary detail and treat it as the clue that will expose the entire hidden story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ignore the missing painting for a moment. Why is that thread red?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's from my scarf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why is it on the empty frame?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I brushed against it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The thread has finally acquired a witness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The painting's gone. That red thread on its frame will explain everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My scarf caught there last night. Can we open the gallery?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This thread will date the theft. Was the painting there then?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. But I picked that thread off before leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this one means someone came back wearing your scarf. Keep it on; we'll reconstruct the whole night from this snag.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 isolates red thread and A3 pursues its location, but A5 does not connect it to the entire theft.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's scarf leads to A3's location question; B4's contact makes B the witness in A5.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 answer credibly but reveal no competing need beyond explaining the thread.

heightening.evidence: A5 renames B a witness without increasing the thread's explanatory reach.

specificity.evidence: A1's missing painting and A3's empty frame provide a clear investigative setting.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's thread acquiring a witness is compact and tied to B4's admission.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 declares that one red thread will explain everything; A3 and A5 keep treating that ordinary detail as the route to the entire theft.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 identifies a scarf snag, which A3 uses to date the disappearance; B4 says that thread was removed, prompting A5's return-visit theory.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to open the gallery and supplies an innocent explanation; B4 complicates the evidence, and A5 recruits B into a reconstruction.

heightening.evidence: After B4 removes the original thread from the timeline, A5 escalates from dating the theft to reconstructing the whole night through the scarf.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a missing painting and a thread on its frame; B2 adds the gallery-opening pressure and the scarf's contact with the frame.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's practical timing question becomes A5's excessive commitment to reconstructing everything from a snag, without introducing a separate joke.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 dates the scarf's contact to last night; A3 asks whether the painting was present at that moment.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 establishes removal of the earlier thread; A5 interprets the present thread as evidence of a second scarf visit.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A's certainty that this single snag exposes the hidden story explains the overconfident inference in A5.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 commits B and the scarf to a whole-night reconstruction, enlarging the investigation around the same detail.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A makes one ordinary trace the privileged clue through which the whole hidden event must be explained.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General investigation follows multiple relevant clues; this stance gives one selected detail disproportionate explanatory power.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 explicitly sidelines the painting for the thread, and A5 continues centring the thread.

records.recommendedEdit: Specified a gallery opening and removed the candidate's solved wedding-gift explanation and competing document. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A1/A3/A5 make the same thread explain everything, timing and an entire night; logic 4, B2's snag prompts A3's timing question and B4's removal prompts A5's return theory, although scarf identity is an overreach; relationship 4, B2 wants to open while A5 prolongs reconstruction through B's clothing; heightening 4, A5 turns an apparently explained snag into evidence of a return visit; specificity 5, A1/B2 establish missing art, frame, scarf and gallery opening; wit 4, A5's request to keep the scarf on makes the exaggerated inference playable. Total 87. Five spoken turns, 64 words; original firstPass preserved.
records.remainingConcern: A5 assumes the same scarf produced the replacement thread and that B currently wears it. The first leap is card-driven; the second is a small staging convenience. No rewrite needed for an internal pass.
records.writerReservation: The replacement thread does not prove the same scarf returned. That unwarranted explanatory certainty is A's stance, and B can challenge it; the dialogue neither identifies a thief nor resolves the opening decision. Model reread only.
records.alternativeComparison: This alternative pressures a gallery colleague through a theft reconstruction. The coffee-ring alternative involves domestic departure pressure and changes the mystery after the keys are found.

cards.title: Official Interpreter
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the final authority on what the impossible situation means, correcting every interpretation that threatens your version of reality.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The wardrobe isn't escaping. It's demonstrating freedom of position.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's halfway down the road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An advanced demonstration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should we chase it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Escort it. Vocabulary matters when dealing with liberated furniture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our wardrobe isn't escaping. It's exercising its freedom of position.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's taking my work clothes down the road. Help me stop it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll escort it. Ask politely for your uniform; this is a free wardrobe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It wants rent for storing my shirts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a proposal, not a demand. Bring our tenancy agreement; a free wardrobe can negotiate its share of the bedroom.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 rejects escape as an interpretation; A5 corrects B4's chasing into escorting.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 absorbs B2's distance as an advanced demonstration; A5 specifically corrects B4's proposed chase.

relationship.evidence: B4 seeks an actionable response, and A5 supplies one while retaining interpretive authority.

heightening.evidence: A5 extends the preferred explanation into how both characters should approach the wardrobe.

specificity.evidence: B2 locates the escaping wardrobe halfway down the road, making the impossible problem concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's chase/escort correction follows A1's freedom language, though its last sentence explains the joke.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 declares movement a freedom; A3 corrects stopping into escorting; A5 corrects rent extraction into a negotiable proposal.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's departing uniform prompts A3's polite retrieval; B4's rent request prompts A5's tenancy negotiation within the same freedom doctrine.

relationship.evidence: B2 urgently needs work clothes and help stopping the wardrobe; A3 offers a constrained solution, while B4 introduces its financial demand.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's rent demand into a claim on the bedroom agreement, extending the wardrobe's autonomy into household obligations.

specificity.evidence: A1's escaping wardrobe and B2's work clothes establish impossible action and ordinary stakes; A5 supplies a concrete tenancy document.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'this is a free wardrobe' sustains A1's interpretation; A5's proposal correction earns its joke through the same legalistic sincerity.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 asks to stop the departing clothes; A3 substitutes escorting and a polite uniform request to preserve the wardrobe's freedom.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 reports rent for shirt storage; A5 insists it is a proposal and introduces the household tenancy agreement.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A authoritatively corrects each threatening interpretation to preserve the wardrobe's legitimate autonomy.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 institutionalises A1's interpretation through a negotiation about the bedroom.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A maintains final authority over the impossible event by correcting descriptions and actions that threaten A's interpretation.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Impossible Specialist specifies technical handling; this card chiefly protects an authoritative account of what the event means.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 replaces 'escaping' with freedom, and A5 insists on 'escort' to preserve that interpretation.

records.recommendedEdit: Kept the liberated wardrobe and supplied B's work clothes as a practical stake. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A1/A3/A5 preserve freedom by correcting escape, restraint and demanded rent; logic 5, B2's uniform need causes polite retrieval and B4's rent claim causes a reciprocal tenancy proposal; relationship 4, B2 urgently needs clothing and B4 complicates access; heightening 4, A5 extends furniture freedom into financial responsibility; specificity 5, B2/A5 ground the impossible movement in clothes and a shared bedroom; wit 4, A5's rent negotiation follows B4's claim. Total 92. Five spoken turns, 70 words; no predetermined settlement.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed in this review. B4 reports the wardrobe's demand more than advancing B's own tactic, and the final tenancy phrasing is slightly elaborate.
records.writerReservation: The wardrobe's ability to communicate enters through B4. A's proposed financial responsibility must sincerely follow the freedom claim, rather than become a detached punishment.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved doorway alternative defends household ownership against a past self. This candidate grants autonomy to a possession and converts retrieval into bargaining.

cards.title: Prophecy Under Revision
cards.instruction: Project absolute certainty about what happens next while quietly revising the prophecy whenever reality disagrees.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A great visitor will arrive wearing gold today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only the plumber came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brass fittings. A regional form of gold.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He left already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As foretold by the phrase great efficiency.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set our best plates out. A visitor wearing gold will bring us a fortune tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the plumber with brass fittings. I'll get his payment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Working gold. Leave the money; he'll be bringing ours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His bill's enormous. We owe him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fortune changing hands. Fetch the chequebook; once he leaves, we'll never have to pay a plumber again.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 predicts a golden visitor and A3 redefines gold, but A5 becomes retrospective without a next prediction.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's plumber; A5 invents 'great efficiency,' a phrase absent from A1's prophecy.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 correct the record without expressing a stake in the visitor's arrival.

heightening.evidence: A5 protects the prediction from B4's departure but does not increase its future commitment.

specificity.evidence: A3's brass fittings tie the celestial claim to B2's ordinary plumber.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'regional form of gold' is a concise, character-driven reinterpretation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 confidently predicts gold and a fortune; A3 recasts brass as 'Working gold', and A5 silently changes receiving money into money changing hands.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's plumber and brass fittings directly supply A3's reinterpretation; B4's enormous bill causes A5 to reverse the payment direction and fetch the chequebook.

relationship.evidence: B2 intends to pay the plumber and B4 insists they owe him; A3 briefly obstructs payment before A5 incorporates B's practical solution into the prophecy.

heightening.evidence: B4 forces A5 to accept a costly contradiction, which A covers with an even broader certainty that they will never pay a plumber again.

specificity.evidence: A1's best plates establish expectant hospitality, while B2's brass fittings and B4's bill turn the visitor into a concrete household expense.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Working gold' and A5's 'A fortune changing hands' compactly expose the revisions; the last prediction continues the same self-protective logic.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies the visitor as a plumber carrying brass and proposes payment; A3 reclassifies the metal and insists money will flow toward them.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 establishes the large debt; A5 broadens the prophecy to cover outgoing money and authorises the payment B sought.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A repeatedly preserves absolute certainty by changing the meaning of the original prediction, then supplies another absolute prediction in A5.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 absorbs the financial reversal and raises the next claim to permanent freedom from plumbing expenses. That claim remains playable and contestable.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A repeatedly adjusts a prophecy's meaning while continuing to announce its imminent fulfilment with certainty.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: A retrospective excuse only explains failure; this stance also sustains certainty about what will happen next.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A3 substitutes brass for gold to preserve A1's prediction despite B2's ordinary arrival.

records.recommendedEdit: Kept the candidate's plumber and dinner setting, replacing the explanatory fortune reversal and unsupported hospitality forecast. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A3 quietly reclassifies brass and A5 drops the promised direction of payment while confidently predicting permanent freedom from bills; logic 4, B2's payment plan prompts A3's refusal and B4's enormous bill prompts A5's payment instruction, though the permanent benefit is A's unsupported prophecy; relationship 4, B2/B4 pursue an obligation A repeatedly reframes; heightening 4, A5 converts immediate loss into a larger future guarantee; specificity 5, A1/B2/B4 establish dinner, fittings and a bill, with A5 giving a concrete payment task; wit 4, A5's brief 'changing hands' quietly absorbs the reversal before renewing certainty. Total 87. Five spoken turns, 59 words; original firstPass preserved.
records.remainingConcern: The final lifelong prediction is broader and less quietly evasive than the earlier revisions, but it remains grounded in the plumber's bill. No rewrite needed for an internal pass.
records.writerReservation: The final guarantee is deliberately unjustified, and A should deliver it as prophecy rather than ordinary confidence in the repair. B can still dispute the bill or the prediction; the scene does not establish future fulfilment. Model review only.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved telescope alternative postpones fulfilment through increasingly strained time-zone explanations. This candidate revises material and financial meanings while a household partner successfully gets a bill paid.

cards.title: Obviously One of Us
cards.instruction: Act as though effortless acceptance of the bizarre premise proves you belong, and treat visible confusion as a personal risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course I know the cloud salute. This hand means welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It means release the rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The previous clouds used it differently.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're getting soaked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An enthusiastic response. Clearly they recognise me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can introduce me to your cloud family. I know the salute: this hand means welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's rain. Shall I tell them you're new?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need. The previous clouds used it differently. Your family will appreciate the traditional greeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mother's raining directly on you. Come under my umbrella.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And refuse her welcome? Hold my phone; I'll greet your father with both hands.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asserts prior knowledge; A3 invokes previous clouds and A5 treats the mistake as personal recognition.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's corrected salute causes A3's historical excuse; B4's soaking becomes A5's enthusiastic response.

relationship.evidence: B4 shares the wet consequence and challenges A's attempt to preserve insider status.

heightening.evidence: A5 treats worsening physical consequences as stronger evidence that A belongs.

specificity.evidence: A1's hand salute causes the rain identified in B2 and experienced in B4.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Clearly they recognise me' completes the social defence without explanatory padding.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims knowledge of the cloud salute; A3 rejects being identified as new; A5 accepts getting soaked to preserve belonging.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's rain correction becomes A3's traditional-greeting defence; B4's umbrella offer becomes A5's refusal to reject Mother's welcome.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers an introduction that could excuse ignorance; B4 offers shelter. A's status anxiety transforms both helpful offers into risks.

heightening.evidence: After B4 reports direct rain, A5 refuses shelter and doubles the greeting with both hands, increasing bodily commitment to claimed fluency.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes meeting B's cloud family; B4's umbrella and A5's phone give actors clear practical choices despite loosely defined salute mechanics.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'And refuse her welcome?' directly reuses A3's greeting defence; handing over the phone makes the escalation concrete and economical.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 exposes the mistaken salute and offers to identify A as new; A3 claims older expertise to avoid that identification.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers shelter from Mother's rain; A5 treats shelter as rejecting the welcome and escalates the greeting to Father.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A consistently sacrifices correction and comfort to appear effortlessly familiar with B's impossible family customs.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns an offered rescue into a reason to demonstrate even greater belonging.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A protects insider status by presenting a mistaken response to the bizarre as established familiarity and personal recognition.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Generic face-saving could concern any mistake; this card makes acceptance of an impossible custom the test of belonging.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 claims experience with previous clouds, and A5 interprets rain as the clouds recognising A.

records.recommendedEdit: Added an introduction to B's cloud family, giving apparent familiarity a personal acceptance stake. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A3 declines novice status and A5 treats shelter as rejecting a welcome; logic 5, B2's correction causes the historical excuse and B4's offered umbrella causes a stronger exposed greeting; relationship 4, B2/B4 offer tactful help A cannot comfortably accept; heightening 4, A5 commits both hands to the rain-producing salute; specificity 4, A1/B4 establish family and directed rain, though the cloud embodiment remains open; wit 4, A5's phone handover practically enables the doubled greeting. Total 90. Five spoken turns, 71 words.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed in this review. The precise relationship between the hand signal and rainfall remains loose, but the status choice is clear.
records.writerReservation: B's relationship to A is deliberately unspecified beyond sponsoring the family introduction. The clouds' approval is A's interpretation; increased rain or acceptance is not prescribed.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved invisible-guest alternative protects membership through ceremonial reinterpretation. This candidate seeks acceptance by B's family and refuses practical protection to maintain that claim.

cards.title: Senior in the Strange
cards.instruction: Treat yourself as an experienced guide to impossible customs, offering patient instruction while preserving one unexplained advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bow to the shadow first. Beginners waste their greeting on the person.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why the shadow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It follows you longer. Basic courtesy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I use your quick bow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After your shadow stops looking inexperienced.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your first shadow banquet, bow until the host's shadow bows back. Take your time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You only nodded. Mine's still waiting, and dinner's starting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I have a standing courtesy. Lower your head a little; let it see you mean it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's lying flat across the dining-room door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, a full welcome. Stay bowed while we step over; I'll bring your plate so you needn't offend it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 instructs a beginner; A3 patiently explains courtesy and A5 withholds A's quicker method.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's reason question; A5 conditions access to the shortcut requested in B4.

relationship.evidence: B4 asks for equal access to A's quick bow, revealing the guide's protected advantage.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B's own shadow subject to training when B4 tries to bypass the lesson.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a shadow-greeting lesson, and B4 identifies A's visibly easier version.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's inexperienced shadow extends the greeting premise and preserves the shortcut in one sentence.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 patiently teaches shadow etiquette; A3 reserves a 'standing courtesy'; A5 continues instruction while retaining freedom to enter dinner.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 challenges A's abbreviated bow, prompting A3's privilege claim; B4's flattened shadow prompts A5's stepping-over arrangement.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants dinner and equal treatment; A3 denies the shortcut, while A5 offers a plate without relinquishing the unequal ritual.

heightening.evidence: B4's shadow across the doorway becomes A5's reason for keeping B bowed while others enter, with helpful food service preserving the disadvantage.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a first shadow banquet and a bow; B4 supplies a doorway obstruction, though 'Mine' in B2 leaves the shadow's identity slightly unclear.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'standing courtesy' neatly protects the unexplained advantage; A5's plate offer extends patient superiority without a detached joke.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 contrasts A's nod with B's prolonged bow; A3 invokes a private courtesy and gives B further beginner instruction.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 places the shadow flat across the doorway; A5 interprets it as welcome and directs continued bowing while others cross.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A patiently interprets impossible etiquette while keeping A's exemption unexplained.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5's helpful plate delivery allows A to preserve the unequal access to dinner.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A patiently teaches impossible etiquette while keeping a personal shortcut inaccessible and unexplained.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Impossible Specialist can teach procedures openly; this card additionally preserves the guide's unequal advantage.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: B4 identifies A's quick bow, and A5 withholds it behind the unexplained standard of an experienced shadow.

records.recommendedEdit: Added a banquet and made B observe A's shortcut before needing it. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A3 protects an unexplained courtesy while A1/A3/A5 patiently teach; logic 5, B2's waiting causes a deeper bow and B4's doorway-spanning response causes continued bowing with meal delivery; relationship 4, B2 wants dinner and A5 offers useful accommodation without sharing the exemption; heightening 4, the greeting becomes an obligation lasting into dinner; specificity 4, A1/B4 locate banquet and doorway, though shadow response requires shared imagined space; wit 4, A5's considerate plate service entrenches unequal etiquette. Total 90. Five spoken turns, 75 words. Unlike b's delegated mirror problem, a prolongs B's ceremonial posture.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed in this review. Shadow ownership is slightly ambiguous, and the patient delivery must remain sincere rather than become overt mockery.
records.writerReservation: The host's shadow lying flat requires a clear spoken spatial agreement. A's food offer should feel patient and helpful, without turning the guide into an openly mocking gatekeeper.
records.alternativeComparison: This alternative preserves privilege by helping a novice endure a public ritual. The mirror alternative protects a private arrangement when the novice's reflection starts investigating it.

cards.title: Senior in the Strange
cards.instruction: Treat yourself as an experienced guide to impossible customs, offering patient instruction while preserving one unexplained advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before entering the mirror, practise the backwards introduction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You walked straight through.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I have an arrangement with my reflection.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I get one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finish apologising to your left hand first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To enter the mirror, introduce yourself backwards. Slowly; give your reflection time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You walked straight through. Could your reflection introduce me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We have a private arrangement. Try your surname first; I'll wait here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's asking yours how to get an arrangement. Neither will let me through.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A useful conversation. Gently turn yours towards you; I'll distract mine. We'll practise introductions without discussing my terms.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 teaches mirror entry and A3 reserves an arrangement, but A5 gives a disconnected lesson rather than patient guidance.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 explains B2's unequal entry; A5 says 'Finish apologising' although no apology has been established.

relationship.evidence: B2 notices privilege and B4 asks how to obtain it, pressing directly on A's advantage.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds a barrier but switches from introduction to apology without a causal bridge.

specificity.evidence: A1's mirror entrance and B2's observed walk-through clearly establish unequal access.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's arrangement is economical; A5's left-hand apology risks an unrelated fantasy flourish.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 patiently teaches backwards introductions; A3 claims a private arrangement; A5 redirects inquiry to keep its terms unexplained.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 requests access through A's reflection, prompting A3's refusal and surname exercise; B4's reflection conference prompts A5's distraction plan.

relationship.evidence: B2 seeks the shortcut A enjoyed; B4 threatens its secrecy through the reflections, forcing A5 to offer active help while protecting privilege.

heightening.evidence: B4 makes the reflections discuss access terms; A5 escalates from withholding an explanation to coordinating distraction under a teaching pretext.

cards.title: The One Normal Thing
cards.instruction: Remain modest while controlling the single ordinary resource everyone needs to survive the increasingly impossible situation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm nobody important. I just have the only spoon that stays solid.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need it for the floating soup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. One bowl at a time, through me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you lend it out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd hate to become important through poor spoon management.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm just serving soup. This spoon's the last utensil that hasn't melted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're starving, and the soup's floating out of reach. Let me use it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll catch it for everyone. Send the smallest children first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's rising towards the ceiling. I'll lift you if you feed my daughter next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'm only the server; you're the legs. Carry me from child to child, and I'll portion what we catch.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 combines modesty with the only solid spoon; A3 controls access, but survival and increasing impossibility are lightly established.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 responds to B2's soup need; A5 rejects B4's lending proposal through a management rationale.

specificity.evidence: A1's solid spoon and B2's floating soup create a clear distribution problem.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'poor spoon management' follows the control game, though its importance claim is somewhat self-conscious.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 modestly identifies the last usable spoon; A3 keeps control of serving; A5 repeats 'only the server' while allocating food.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks for the spoon to reach floating soup; A3 retains it as communal server. B4 offers lifting for priority, and A5 accepts that arrangement.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants food and access to the utensil; B4 bargains using needed physical help and concern for a daughter, materially changing A5's method.

heightening.evidence: B4 raises the soup beyond reach; A5 becomes a carried distributor, increasing dependence on A's spoon while sharing the physical work.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes melted utensils; B2 adds floating soup; B4 supplies a playable lift, though catching portions of airborne soup remains loosely specified.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'I'm only the server; you're the legs' earns its modest authority through B4's offer, then states the serving arrangement clearly.

Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A1/A5 disclaim status while A3/A5 retain serving and allocation; logic 5, B2's hunger causes prioritized feeding and B4's lift bargain causes mobile service with B as support; relationship 5, B4 bargains for a daughter using help A now needs; heightening 4, A5 extends resource control into directing B's movement; specificity 4, B2/B4 establish starvation and rising soup, though its containment is implicit; wit 4, A5's server/legs division follows B4's offer. records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed in this review. Airborne portioning requires a shared physical convention, and the daughter's promised priority is accepted implicitly through 'Of course.'
records.writerReservation: B's lifting offer supplies leverage over A, so the resource holder is not all-powerful. The spoken fantasy need not involve a performed lift; the next serving outcome remains open.
